report_name: AI Compresses Attack Timelines from Weeks to Days, Sophos Reports

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Attackers use AI to craft more convincing and personalized phishing emails to harvest credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
attack_patterns.description: Attackers use AI to automate reconnaissance to quickly identify high-value targets and their credentials from public sources.

attack_patterns.name: Develop Capabilities
attack_patterns.description: AI is used to assist attackers in finding bugs in code, generating proof-of-concept exploits for known vulnerabilities, and modifying existing malware to bypass security controls.

attack_patterns.name: Search Open Websites/Domains
attack_patterns.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) are used to rapidly parse public information from social media, company websites, and breach dumps to build detailed profiles of targets.

attack_patterns.name: Generate Deepfakes
attack_patterns.description: AI-assisted social engineering, including deepfakes for voice and video, are used as operational tools by criminals for social engineering campaigns.

attack_patterns.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
attack_patterns.description: AI assists in the development of polymorphic malware that can evade signature-based detection.

tools.name: Large Language Models
tools.description: Large Language Models are used by attackers as a force multiplier to accelerate attack workflows, including reconnaissance, social engineering, and malware development.

indicators.name: Anomalous Public AI Service API Access
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Public AI Service API Access
id: 9b8c1a2d-f3e4-4d5c-b6a7-890123456789
status: experimental
description: Detects network traffic to common public AI service APIs from potentially anomalous sources, which could indicate a compromised system being used for AI-assisted attack staging or data analysis.
references:
  - https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/22/3331164/0/en/AI-Is-Compressing-Cyberattack-Timelines-and-Targeting-Ungoverned-AI-Identities-Sophos-AI-Security-Report-Finds.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-22
tags:
  - attack.t1090.002
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_hosts:
    cs-host|endswith:
      - 'api.openai.com'
      - 'api.anthropic.com'
      - 'generativelanguage.googleapis.com'
  filter_legit_ua:
    c-useragent|startswith:
      - 'Mozilla/'
      - 'Opera/'
      - 'curl/'
      - 'Python-urllib/'
      - 'Go-http-client/'
  condition: selection_hosts and not filter_legit_ua
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to common public AI service APIs from potentially anomalous user agents, which could indicate a compromised account or system being used for AI-assisted attack staging or data analysis.

relationships.source_name: Anomalous Public AI Service API Access
